zh: 我期待周末和朋友去看电影。
old_en: I'm looking forward to seeing a movie with friends this weekend.
new_en: I look forward to watching a movie with friends this weekend.

zh: 我期待下周的旅行，想去很多地方。
old_en: I'm looking forward to next week's trip, I want to visit many places.
new_en: I look forward to next week's trip because I want to visit many places.

zh: 我期待这次考试成绩，因为复习得很充分。
old_en: I'm looking forward to the exam results, because I studied really well.
new_en: I look forward to the exam results since I studied thoroughly.

zh: 我期待这次的假期，因为我需要放松一下。
old_en: I'm looking forward to this vacation, because I need to relax.
new_en: I look forward to this vacation because I need to relax.
